results.name: The profiles list never includes an ElevenLabs voiceId or API key
Every mentor has an explicit active boolean (no ambiguous voice availability)
A genuinely fresh guest can request a preview without a prior identity round-trip
A preview request with no mentorId is rejected
A preview request for an unknown mentor is rejected (never fabricates a mentor)
An active mentor honestly reports "unavailable" (provider_not_configured) rather than fabricating audio
A mentor with no configured voice honestly reports "unavailable" (no_voice_configured)
Every preview response includes a real transcript regardless of audio availability
Every preview response includes a real request ID
Saved preferences persist and are read back exactly (refresh persistence, same cookie identity)
A second independent fetch under the same identity returns identical preferences (no per-device drift)
An invalid voiceEnabled type is rejected, not silently coerced
A completely separate guest gets their own default preferences, never another guest's saved values
One guest saving preferences never leaks into or overwrites a different guest's preferences
